records.label: spacr.diameter#6
records.source: 1. **Flatten.** Denoise with a 1 px Gaussian, then subtract a heavily smoothed copy (sigma = max(32, min(H, W) / 4)) to remove illumination gradients. The sigma is deliberately far larger than any plausible object so that flattening removes vignetting without eating the objects — the opposite trade-off (a tight rolling ball) shrinks what it is trying to measure. 2. **Reject noise.** Compare the structural amplitude of the flattened plane (p99 - p30) against the *pixel-level* noise scale, measured as ``1.4826 * MAD(img - gaussian(img, 1))`` on the raw plane. A pure-noise plane scores below 1; a plane with real objects scores in the tens. Below ``min_snr`` the field is discarded rather than thresholded, because Otsu will happily bisect pure noise and hand back a confident-looking number. 3. **Threshold and label.** Otsu, fill holes, label, drop components that touch the image border (truncated, so their size is a lie) and components that are absurd (equivalent diameter below ``min_object_diameter``, or area above ``max_object_fraction`` of the field). Characteristic size is the median equivalent diameter, ``2 * sqrt(area / pi)``. 4. **Cross-check by distance transform.** Step 3 has one dominant failure mode: a confluent monolayer fuses into a single component, that component touches the border and is dropped, and the estimate is then computed from whatever debris survived — biased **low**, and silently. So the Euclidean distance transform of the (unfilled) foreground is computed as well, its local maxima are taken as one seed per object (two passes: a coarse pass sets the suppression radius for the refined pass), and a watershed on ``-EDT`` splits the fused foreground back into objects whose equivalent diameters are measured the same way.
records.context: 1. **Flatten.** Apply a 1 px Gaussian filter, then subtract a smoother copy with sigma = max(32, min(H, W) / 4). This sigma is larger than a plausible object, so it removes vignetting without the object shrinkage caused by a tight rolling ball. 2. **Reject noise.** Compare the flattened plane’s structural amplitude (p99 - p30) with the *pixel-level* raw-plane noise estimate ``1.4826 * MAD(img - gaussian(img, 1))``. Pure noise scores below 1; real objects score in the tens. Discard a field below ``min_snr`` instead of applying Otsu to pure noise. 3. **Threshold and label.** Apply Otsu, fill holes, and label components. Remove border-touching components because they are truncated; also remove equivalent diameters below ``min_object_diameter`` and areas above ``max_object_fraction``. Use the median equivalent diameter, ``2 * sqrt(area / pi)``. 4. **Cross-check by distance transform.** A confluent layer can fuse into one border-touching component, which is discarded and leaves debris that biases the estimate silently **low**. Compute the Euclidean distance transform of the unfilled foreground. Use local maxima as object seeds in two passes: a coarse pass sets the suppression radius for the refined pass. Watershed on ``-EDT`` separates the fused foreground before measuring equivalent diameters the same way.
records.translation: 1. **展平。** 先用 1 px 高斯滤波去噪，再减去一个更平滑的副本，其平滑尺度取 32 与图像短边四分之一两者中的较大值。该尺度大于任何合理的对象，因此能够去除渐晕，又不会像半径过小的滚动球那样缩小对象。2. **拒绝噪声。** 将展平图像层的结构振幅（p99 - p30）与原始图像层的*像素级*噪声估计 ``1.4826 * MAD(img - gaussian(img, 1))`` 比较。纯噪声得分低于 1，真实对象通常达到数十。低于 ``min_snr`` 的视野会被丢弃，而不是对纯噪声应用 Otsu。3. **阈值化并标记。** 应用 Otsu、填充孔洞并标记连通分量。删除接触边界的分量，因为它们已被截断；还要删除等效直径低于 ``min_object_diameter`` 或面积高于 ``max_object_fraction`` 的分量。使用等效直径中位数 ``2 * sqrt(area / pi)``。4. **通过距离变换交叉检查。** 汇合层可能融合成一个接触边界的分量；该分量被删除后，只留下碎屑，导致估计在无提示的情况下**偏低**。因此还要计算未填充前景的欧氏距离变换。用局部极大值作为对象种子，并分两遍处理：粗略遍历确定精细遍历的抑制半径。最后在 ``-EDT`` 上进行分水岭，将融合前景分开，再以相同方式测量等效直径。

records.source: :class:`spacr.qt.prerun.DiameterPanel` sits above the Run row on the Mask screen: it reads the channels off the settings form with :func:`channels_from_settings`, calls :func:`estimate_diameters` on a worker thread, and shows one row per object type carrying the proposal *and its evidence* — the 10th-90th percentile range, how many objects it was pooled from, how many fields contributed, the method and the confidence. A proposal without those is just a different guess. Nothing is written into ``<object>_diameter`` until the user presses **Use**, and :attr:`DiameterEstimate.usable` is checked first, so the NaN an unmeasurable channel returns cannot reach a settings field.

records.label: spacr.foreign#7
records.source: 1. **A guessed mapping applied without review.** Their ``Area`` in µm² written into spaCR's ``cell_area`` in px² is a number that is wrong by a factor of a few hundred and looks completely plausible. So :func:`infer_column_map` only ever *proposes*; the proposal is a file the user edits (:func:`save_column_map` / :func:`load_column_map`); and :func:`run_import` applies what was agreed, nothing else. 2. **Units.** spaCR's intensities are raw uncalibrated counts, and its geometry is px²/px for a 2-D run — but a 3-D run measures volumes, in µm³ when it was given voxel_size_z_um/voxel_size_xy_um, under the same column names; the row's ``measurement_units`` says which, and :mod:`spacr.feature_dict` resolves it per table. A foreign table in µm needs a scale factor unless the target rows are µm too, and every mapping therefore carries ``unit_in`` / ``unit_out``. When a conversion is declared but the pixel size is unknown, the value is **not** multiplied by 1.0 and pretended to be pixels: the column is redirected to the ``foreign_`` prefix, recorded with its own unit and ``calibrated = 0``, and named in the plan and the summary. 3. **Columns that could not be mapped.** They are listed by name in the plan, in :meth:`ImportResult.summary`, and in the ``foreign_columns`` table — and they are still *imported*, under the ``foreign_`` prefix. Dropping a column the user cared about, quietly, is the failure mode this exists to prevent. 4. **Name collisions.** A foreign column called ``cell_area`` that means something else would corrupt every downstream analysis with no error at all. Targets are checked against :func:`spacr.feature_dict.parse_column` and against spaCR's reserved key columns; a collision is a :class:`Conflict` that either refuses the import (``on_conflict='refuse'``, the default) or renames the column (``on_conflict='rename'``) — never an overwrite. 5. **A destination that is already somebody's project.** The same argument one level up: a *table* collision. See below.

records.translation: 1. **未经审核就采用猜测的映射。** 如果把对方以 µm² 表示的 ``Area`` 写入 spaCR 以 px² 表示的 ``cell_area``，数值会相差几百倍，却仍显得完全合理。因此 :func:`infer_column_map` 只会*提出*映射建议；该建议保存为供用户编辑的文件（:func:`save_column_map` / :func:`load_column_map`）；:func:`run_import` 只应用已经确认的映射。2. **单位。** spaCR 的强度是未经校准的原始计数，二维运行的几何单位为 px²/px；但三维运行测量的是体积，若提供了 voxel_size_z_um/voxel_size_xy_um，则同名列使用 µm³。行中的 ``measurement_units`` 说明实际单位，:mod:`spacr.feature_dict` 会按表解析。除非目标行也使用 µm，否则以 µm 表示的外部表需要比例因子，因此每项映射都携带 ``unit_in`` / ``unit_out``。若声明了转换但像素大小未知，数值**不会**乘以 1.0 后假装成像素；该列会改用 ``foreign_`` 前缀，连同自身单位和 ``calibrated = 0`` 一起记录，并在计划和摘要中列出。3. **无法映射的列。** 这些列会按名称列在计划、:meth:`ImportResult.summary` 和 ``foreign_columns`` 表中，而且仍会以 ``foreign_`` 前缀*导入*。本功能正是为了避免静默丢弃用户关心的列。4. **名称冲突。** 若名为 ``cell_area`` 的外部列含义不同，它会在没有任何错误的情况下破坏所有下游分析。目标会同时依据 :func:`spacr.feature_dict.parse_column` 和 spaCR 的保留标识符列进行检查；冲突表示为 :class:`Conflict`，要么拒绝导入（默认的 ``on_conflict='refuse'``），要么重命名列（``on_conflict='rename'``），绝不会覆盖。5. **目标已经属于另一个项目。** 这是上一条在*表*级别的同一问题：表冲突。详见下文。

records.label: spacr.foreign.release_canonical_copy#1
records.source: ``run_import`` copies the imported frame into the canonical ``cell`` / ``nucleus`` / ``pathogen`` table when nothing of anyone else's is there, so that a project built purely by import is readable by every spaCR tool. That copy is a *convenience*, and it stops being one the moment spaCR measures the same project itself: measure appends, so its rows would land in the same table beside theirs, and every per-well count downstream would be the sum of two populations with nothing marking the seam.

That copy is a *convenience*, and it stops being one the moment spaCR measures the same project itself: measure appends, so its rows would land in the same table beside theirs, and every per-microplate sample position count downstream would be the sum of two populations with nothing marking the seam.
records.translation: ``run_import`` 会在规范的 ``cell`` / ``nucleus`` / ``pathogen`` 表中没有其他人的数据时，把导入的数据框复制进去，使完全通过导入建立的项目也能被所有 spaCR 工具读取。该副本只是为了*方便*；一旦 spaCR 自己测量同一项目，它就不再方便：测量会追加数据，因此新行会与导入行落在同一张表中，之后每个微孔板样本位置的计数都会把两个群体相加，却没有任何内容标出两者的边界。

records.label: spacr.hyperparam.classify_cv_fit_fn#1
records.source: The Classify (CV) app trains Torch CNNs, so the search does not roll its own folds: it hands each configuration to :func:`spacr.deep_spacr. train_test_model` with ``cross_validation_folds`` forced to at least two and ``cv_group_by`` left alone, then reads the per-fold CSV that run writes. That keeps a single implementation of grouped k-fold — spaCR's — and means the search splits the data exactly the way the training run will.
records.context: The Classify (CV) app trains Torch CNNs, so the search does not roll its own folds: it hands each configuration to :func:`spacr.deep_spacr. train_test_model` with ``cross_validation_folds`` forced to at least two and ``cv_group_by`` left alone, then reads the per-fold CSV that processing session writes. That keeps a single implementation of grouped k-fold — spaCR's — and means the search splits the data exactly the way the training processing session will.
records.translation: Classify (CV) 应用使用 Torch CNNs 进行训练，因此搜索不会自行实现交叉验证折叠：它把每项配置交给 :func:`spacr.deep_spacr. train_test_model`，强制 ``cross_validation_folds`` 至少为 2，并保持 ``cv_group_by`` 不变，随后读取该处理会话写出的逐折 CSV。这样，分组 k 折只有 spaCR 的一套实现，搜索拆分数据的方式也与训练处理会话完全一致。

records.label: spacr.illumination#10
records.source: *Why the surface fit on top.* Illumination is a physically smooth, low-frequency function of position: a lamp profile plus a vignette. Fitting a low-order 2-D polynomial (default degree 4, 15 terms) to the per-pixel median imposes exactly that prior, so residual object structure and photon noise cannot leak into the gain map and be baked into every measurement on the plate. The fit is trimmed twice against a MAD threshold, so a persistent bright artefact -- a fluorescent speck in the same place on every field -- is rejected rather than smeared into the surface. For illumination that is genuinely not polynomial (a dust shadow, a sharply structured lamp) pass ``estimator='smooth'``: the same per-pixel median, Gaussian-smoothed at 1/16 of the short side and interpolated back to full resolution.
records.context: *Why the surface fit on top.* Illumination is a physically smooth, low-frequency function of position: a lamp profile plus a vignette. Fitting a low-order 2-D polynomial (default degree 4, 15 terms) to the per-pixel median imposes exactly that prior, so residual object structure and photon noise cannot leak into the gain map and be baked into every measurement on the laboratory microplate. The fit is trimmed twice against a MAD threshold, so a persistent bright artefact -- a fluorescent speck in the same place on every microscope field of view -- is rejected rather than smeared into the surface. For illumination that is genuinely not polynomial (a dust shadow, a sharply structured lamp) pass ``estimator='smooth'``: the same per-pixel median, Gaussian-smoothed at 1/16 of the short side and interpolated back to full resolution.
records.translation: *为何还要拟合表面。* 照明在物理上是随位置平滑变化的低频函数，即灯光轮廓与渐晕的组合。对逐像素中位数拟合低阶二维多项式（默认四次，共 15 项），恰好施加了这一先验，因此残余对象结构和光子噪声不会渗入增益图并固化到微孔板的每项测量中。拟合会依据 MAD 阈值修剪两次，所以持续存在的明亮伪影——例如每个显微镜视野同一位置的荧光斑点——会被拒绝，而不会被涂抹进表面。若照明确实不符合多项式形式（如灰尘阴影或结构陡峭的灯光），请传入 ``estimator='smooth'``：仍使用相同的逐像素中位数，以短边的 1/16 作为高斯平滑尺度，再插值回完整分辨率。

records.label: spacr.illumination#11
records.source: *Why not BaSiC.* BaSiC's low-rank + sparse decomposition is the better estimator when you have hundreds of fields and a genuine dark-field to recover, but it is an iterative optimisation with its own convergence failure modes, and its dark-field term is only identifiable because of those extra assumptions. From a single acquisition, ``dark`` and ``flat`` are not separately identifiable at all: multiplying ``flat`` by a constant and absorbing it into the per-field brightness leaves every observation unchanged. Estimating a dark-field anyway -- for instance from the per-pixel minimum across fields, which is the usual shortcut -- returns *dark plus the dimmest background*, and subtracting it removes real signal. So spaCR does not guess: ``dark`` is 0 unless you supply the camera offset you measured from a dark frame, via ``illumination_dark``.
records.context: *Why not BaSiC.* BaSiC's low-rank + sparse decomposition is the better estimator when you have hundreds of microscope fields of view and a genuine dark-microscope field of view to recover, but it is an iterative optimisation with its own convergence failure modes, and its dark-microscope field of view term is only identifiable because of those extra assumptions. From a single acquisition, ``dark`` and ``flat`` are not separately identifiable at all: multiplying ``flat`` by a constant and absorbing it into the per-microscope field of view brightness leaves every observation unchanged. Estimating a dark-microscope field of view anyway -- for instance from the per-pixel minimum across microscope fields of view, which is the usual shortcut -- returns *dark plus the dimmest background*, and subtracting it removes real signal. So spaCR does not guess: ``dark`` is 0 unless you supply the camera offset you measured from a dark frame, via ``illumination_dark``.
records.translation: *为何不用 BaSiC。* 当有数百个显微镜视野并且需要恢复真实暗场时，BaSiC 的低秩加稀疏分解是更好的估计器；但它是具有自身收敛失败模式的迭代优化，而且暗场项只有依靠那些额外假设才能辨识。对于单次采集，``dark`` 与 ``flat`` 根本无法分别辨识：把 ``flat`` 乘以常数，再将该常数吸收到每个视野的亮度中，所有观测都不会改变。如果仍然估计暗场——例如采用常见捷径，对所有视野取逐像素最小值——所得其实是*暗场加最暗背景*，减去它会移除真实信号。因此 spaCR 不会猜测：``dark`` 为 0；只有通过 ``illumination_dark`` 提供从暗帧实测的相机偏移时才会改变。

records.label: spacr.logging_util#6
records.source: Third-party libraries that spam INFO records during a spacr pipeline (torch, cellpose, matplotlib, PIL, urllib3, botocore, tensorflow, asyncio) are pinned to WARNING so the log stays useful. Add more to :data:`QUIET_LOGGERS` if a new dependency starts spamming.
records.context: Third-party libraries that spam INFO records during a spacr workflow (torch, cellpose, matplotlib, PIL, urllib3, botocore, tensorflow, asyncio) are pinned to WARNING so the log stays useful. Add more to :data:`QUIET_LOGGERS` if a new dependency starts spamming.
records.translation: 在 spacr 工作流中大量发送 INFO 记录的第三方库（torch 库、cellpose 库、matplotlib 库、PIL 库、urllib3 库、botocore 库、tensorflow 库、asyncio 库）会被固定到 WARNING 级别，以保持日志有用。如果新依赖开始刷屏，请将其加入 :data:`QUIET_LOGGERS`。

records.translation: 把选定的图像数据通道组装成 HxWx3 uint8 图像（1→灰度→RGB，2→填充，3→RGB，>3→前三个）；否则保留 N 个图像数据通道，**并保持合并数组自身的数据类型**。

records.label: spacr.measure.generate_object_dataset#1
records.source: spaCR's ``merged/`` arrays store the image channels first and then one integer label-mask slice per object class (cell, nucleus, pathogen, organelle). The measurements database records, for every object, its integer ``object_label``, the merged ``.npy`` it came from (``path_name``), its well/field metadata, and its features (e.g. ``cell_area``). This function queries that database for the objects you want, then for each hit slices the object out of its array using ``object_label`` and the class mask, assembles the channels you ask for into an image, and saves a PNG.
records.context: spaCR's ``merged/`` arrays store the image data channels first and then one integer label-mask slice per object class (cell, nucleus, pathogen, organelle). The measurements database records, for every object, its integer ``object_label``, the merged ``.npy`` it came from (``path_name``), its well/microscope field of view metadata, and its features (e.g. ``cell_area``). This function queries that database for the objects you want, then for each hit slices the object out of its array using ``object_label`` and the class mask, assembles the image data channels you ask for into an image, and saves a PNG.
records.translation: spaCR 的 ``merged/`` 数组先保存图像数据通道，随后为每个对象类别（细胞、细胞核、病原体、细胞器）保存一个整数标签掩模切片。测量数据库会为每个对象记录其整数 ``object_label``、来源合并 ``.npy`` 文件（``path_name``）、微孔板样本位置/显微镜视野元数据以及特征（例如 ``cell_area``）。本函数先查询数据库以找到所需对象，再对每个命中项使用 ``object_label`` 和类别掩模从数组中切出对象，把请求的图像数据通道组装成图像，并保存为 PNG。

records.label: spacr.measure.generate_object_dataset#5
records.source: image channel indices to include, in output order. Three indices → an RGB image; one → greyscale; two → padded to RGB; more than three → kept as an ``.npy`` array (and the first three saved as a PNG preview when ``save_png``).
records.context: image data channel indices to include, in output order. Three indices → an RGB image; one → greyscale; two → padded to RGB; more than three → kept as an ``.npy`` array (and the first three saved as a PNG preview when ``save_png``).
records.translation: 按输出顺序列出要包含的图像数据通道索引。三个索引 → RGB 图像；一个 → 灰度图像；两个 → 填充为 RGB；超过三个 → 保留为 ``.npy`` 数组（若设置 ``save_png``，还会把前三个通道保存为 PNG 预览）。

records.label: spacr.measure.measure_crop#1
records.source: Consumes the ``merged/`` folder produced by :func:`spacr.core.preprocess_generate_masks` (channel arrays + mask stacks saved as ``.npy``), computes shape, intensity, texture and spatial features per cell / nucleus / pathogen / cytoplasm object, and writes them to a SQLite ``measurements.db``. When ``save_png`` is enabled it also crops per-object PNG thumbnails, which are the training input for :func:`spacr.deep_spacr.deep_spacr`.
records.context: Consumes the ``merged/`` folder produced by :func:`spacr.core.preprocess_generate_masks` (image data channel arrays + mask stacks saved as ``.npy``), computes shape, intensity, texture and spatial features per cell / nucleus / pathogen / cytoplasm object, and writes them to a SQLite ``measurements.db``. When ``save_png`` is enabled it also extracts per-object image regions as PNG thumbnails, which are the training input for :func:`spacr.deep_spacr.deep_spacr`.
records.translation: 读取 ``merged/`` 文件夹；该文件夹由 :func:`spacr.core.preprocess_generate_masks` 生成，其中图像数据通道数组和掩模堆栈均保存为 ``.npy``。随后为每个细胞 / 细胞核 / 病原体 / 细胞质对象计算形状、强度、纹理和空间特征，并写入 SQLite ``measurements.db``。启用 ``save_png`` 时，还会为每个对象提取图像区域并保存为 PNG 缩略图，作为 :func:`spacr.deep_spacr.deep_spacr` 的训练输入。

records.label: spacr.measure.resolve_measurement_spacing#3
records.source: **3-D requires a z/xy relationship and will not invent one.** With anisotropic voxels an unspaced volume is not merely in unusual units: a voxel count is not proportional to a physical volume, a distance transform measures a different length along z than along x, and ``major_axis_length`` mixes the two. This mirrors :func:`spacr.zstack.resolve_anisotropy`, which raises rather than defaulting to 1.0 because "isotropic" is a claim about the microscope, not a neutral value. Set ``voxel_size_z_um`` and ``voxel_size_xy_um`` (preferred -- it also gives physical units), or set ``anisotropy`` alone (correct geometry, xy-pixel units).
records.context: **3-D requires a z/xy relationship and will not invent one.** With anisotropic voxels an unspaced volume is not merely in unusual units: a voxel count is not proportional to a physical volume, a distance transform measures a different length along z than along x, and ``major_axis_length`` mixes the two. This mirrors :func:`spacr.zstack.resolve_anisotropy`, which raises rather than defaulting to 1.0 because "isotropic" is a claim about the microscope, not a neutral value. Set ``voxel_size_z_um`` and ``voxel_size_xy_um`` (preferred -- it also gives physical units), or set ``anisotropy`` alone (correct geometry, xy-pixel units).
records.translation: **三维数据必须具有 z/xy 比例关系，系统不会凭空假定。** 对于各向异性体素，未指定间距的体积并非只是单位不常见：体素计数与物理体积不成比例，距离变换沿 z 轴与沿 x 轴测量的是不同长度，``major_axis_length`` 还会混合两者。这与 :func:`spacr.zstack.resolve_anisotropy` 一致；后者会抛出错误而不会默认采用 1.0，因为 "isotropic" 是对显微镜的判断，并非中性值。请设置 ``voxel_size_z_um`` 和 ``voxel_size_xy_um``（首选，还能得到物理单位），或只设置 ``anisotropy``（几何正确，单位为 xy 像素）。

records.label: spacr.measure.resolve_pool_size#2
records.source: Under ``spawn`` and ``forkserver`` it is not free. Each worker is a fresh interpreter that re-imports the whole measure chain from scratch; measured on a developer box that was **8.1 s and ~1.54 GB of RSS per worker**, and is **3.5 s and ~930 MB** now that ``spacr.plot`` and umap (and, through umap, TensorFlow) are off that path. Either way it is paid before a single field is read. A default ``n_jobs`` of ``cpu_count - 4`` on a 16-core Windows machine therefore boots 12 interpreters and reserves 11-18 GB to measure a 4-field test plate, and the run either swaps itself to a standstill or has workers killed out from under it -- which presents as "Measure prints 'using 12 cpu cores' and then nothing happens", because a pool worker that dies at bootstrap is silently replaced and dies again. Windows and macOS default to ``spawn``; Linux does not, which is exactly why this only ever bit the other two.
records.context: Under ``spawn`` and ``forkserver`` it is not free. Each worker is a fresh interpreter that re-imports the whole measure chain from scratch; measured on a developer box that was **8.1 s and ~1.54 GB of RSS per worker**, and is **3.5 s and ~930 MB** now that ``spacr.plot`` and umap (and, through umap, TensorFlow) are off that path. Either way it is paid before a single microscope field of view is read. A default ``n_jobs`` of ``cpu_count - 4`` on a 16-core Windows machine therefore boots 12 interpreters and reserves 11-18 GB to measure a 4-microscope field of view test laboratory microplate, and the processing session either swaps itself to a standstill or has workers killed out from under it -- which presents as "Measure prints 'using 12 cpu cores' and then nothing happens", because a pool worker that dies at bootstrap is silently replaced and dies again. Windows and macOS default to ``spawn``; Linux does not, which is exactly why this only ever bit the other two.
records.translation: 在 ``spawn`` 和 ``forkserver`` 模式下，创建工作进程并非没有代价。每个工作进程都是全新的解释器，会从头重新导入整个 measure 调用链；开发机上的实测值原为**每个工作进程 8.1 s、约 1.54 GB RSS**，现在 ``spacr.plot`` 和 umap（以及由 umap 引入的 TensorFlow）已移出该路径，仍需**3.5 s、约 930 MB**。无论哪种情况，这些代价都会在读取第一个显微镜视野前支付。如果在 16 核 Windows 机器上把 ``n_jobs`` 默认设为 ``cpu_count - 4``，就会启动 12 个解释器，并为只有 4 个显微镜视野的测试微孔板预留 11-18 GB；处理会话要么因交换而停滞，要么工作进程被系统杀死——表面现象是“Measure 输出 'using 12 cpu cores' 后就没有反应”，因为在启动阶段死亡的池工作进程会被静默替换，然后再次死亡。Windows 和 macOS 默认使用 ``spawn``，Linux 则不是，这正是该问题只影响前两个系统的原因。
